scope: Fix actual C30/C33/C35/C36 failures with targeted regressions and repeat affected checks. Keep unresolved blockers explicit; never invent feedback or weaken an invariant to claim completion (Requirement N37).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C37-owned implementation, test, fixture, and documentation paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao owns sealed secret bytes and engine persists only transit-wrapped DEK envelopes.
invariants_verified.immediate_privilege_reduction: Enforced; revoking a member grant immediately revokes access token validity and denies secret reveal on the very next attempt.
invariants_verified.fail_closed_availability: Enforced; consecutive provider outage drills consistently fail closed with HTTP 503 provider_unavailable and zero plaintext leakage.
invariants_verified.tamper_detection: Enforced; tampered ciphertext payload or auth tag is rejected with HTTP 500 secret_unseal_failed.
invariants_verified.zero_plaintext_at_rest: Enforced; full directory walk over engine and provider data confirms 0 occurrences of secret sentinel bytes.
invariants_verified.port_conflict_safety: Enforced; diagnostic tooling inspects port availability before launch and provides actionable remediations.
